answer: Put every new identity in a frozen tundra: it earns only non-transferable reputation by answering sparrow challenges, fresh unpredictable micro-tasks issued by random established peers, each due within 30 seconds and scored on correctness. One machine can answer only a handful per epoch, so a sybil farm needs one live responsive endpoint per fake. The old fable of the farmer who planted one seed and harvested a thousand ghosts fails here: each identity also locks a 50 POA bond released over 20 epochs, so 1,000 fakes tie up 50,000 POA for months while earning almost nothing.
